subject.title: fix: prevent cron and Workboard lifecycle races

question: Should this large, cross-owner concurrency repair merge after the lint failure is resolved and an inspectable real concurrent-behavior artifact is added?
rationale: The patch spans cron scheduling, gateway behavior, a bundled plugin, and Control UI lifecycle reconciliation; available context supports the intended fixes but does not independently establish all user-visible concurrent paths.

options.title: Request inspectable race proof
options.body: Require a redacted terminal transcript, runtime log, or recording that demonstrates at least one stale cron or Workboard operation being rejected while the valid concurrent update persists.

options.title: Accept the existing Testbox summary
options.body: Merge based on the detailed PR-body test summary once the lint failure is shown unrelated or fixed, accepting that the raw concurrent run is not attached.

options.title: Split by owner boundary
options.body: Land the cron and Workboard portions separately if review cannot confidently validate their combined behavior in one PR.

recommendation.title: Request inspectable race proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted terminal transcript, runtime log, or recording that demonstrates at least one stale cron or Workboard operation being rejected while the valid concurrent update persists.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR context connects this contributor to all affected surfaces, although current-main history should be checked before treating this as durable ownership.
